strings: In m_c's catatonic state, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/were/was} unable to react to an attack by a predator and was killed.
m_c died while catatonic. The healer said it had to do with {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} heart, and there was nothing that could be done.
m_c's catatonic state left {PRONOUN/m_c/object} unable to breathe, and despite the healer's efforts, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} could not be saved.
m_c was catatonic for too long and became dehydrated. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} was unable to recover.
